pairs.evidence: crates/apps/crawl/src/link_graph.rs:4 The only graph in this context is a hyperlink graph keyed by canonical URLs (an external identifier), and the extractor runs declarative or statistically induced rule sets with no LLM. No model ever proposes an entity or relation from prose, so the subject's precondition does not hold; a search of crates/apps/crawl and crates/apps/extractor for embedding, vector_index, extract_entities, gleaning and description_fragments found nothing ("entity" matches only inside "identity").

techniques.evidence: crates/apps/crawl/src/link_graph.rs:28 Node identity is a canonicalized URL, an identifier that exists outside the text. No node is keyed by a name a model produced.
crates/apps/crawl/src/link_graph.rs:29 Edges upsert in place by key through store change detection. No node descriptions are built up from passages, so there is nothing to merge at a threshold.
